 1                           I.    WITNESS IDENTIFICATION AND PURPOSE OF
 2                                       SUPPLEMENTAL TESTIMONY

 3   Q.      Please state your name and business address.

 4   A.      My name is Justin L. Gable. My business address is 790 South Buchanan Street,

 5           Amarillo, Texas 79101.

 6   Q.      On whose behalf are you testifying in this proceeding?

 7   A.      I am filing testimony on behalf of Southwestern Public Service Company, a New

 8           Mexico corporation (“SPS”) and wholly owned electric utility subsidiary of Xcel

 9           Energy Inc (“Xcel Energy”). 1

10   Q.      Are you the same Justin L. Gable who provided direct testimony in this

11           proceeding on November 20, 2025?

12   A.      Yes.

13   Q.      What is the purpose of this supplemental testimony?

14   A.      The purpose of my supplemental testimony is to provide a response to Bench

15           Request No. 1-(i), which requests SPS to provide a loads and resources table




             1
               Xcel Energy is the parent company of four utility operating companies: Northern States Power
     Company, a Minnesota corporation (“NSPM”); Northern States Power Company, a Wisconsin corporation
     (“NSPW”); Public Service Company of Colorado, a Colorado corporation (“PSCo”); and SPS (collectively,
     “Operating Companies”). Xcel Energy’s natural gas pipeline company is WestGas InterState, Inc.

4        control?

5   A.   Yes.

 1                 II.    BENCH REQUEST QUESTIONS ADDRESSED IN THIS
 2                                SUPPLEMENTAL TESTIMONY

 3                            QUESTION NO. NMPRC 1-(i):

 4   Q.   Please provide a loads and resources table showing both current loads and

 5        resources and the projected loads and resources once projects currently

 6        approved and under construction are brought into service.

 7   A.   Please refer to Attachment JLG-BR 1(i). SPS provides this information in an

 8        updated form of Schedule P-11. The revised schedule reflects SPS’s current loads

 9        and resources and projected loads and resources after projects that are approved and

10        under construction enter service.

11   Q.   Does this conclude your pre-filed supplemental testimony?

12   A.   Yes.
